Explanation: Solution: An irregular mode of reproduction resulting in the development of an embryo without fertilisation is called Parthenogenesis or apogamy or sporophytic budding. Parthenogenesis is a natural form of asexual reproduction in which growth and development of embryos occur without fertilisation. Apogamy, a type of reproduction, occurring in some ferns, in which the sporophyte develops from the gametophyte without the fusion of gametes. Explanation: Solution: Inflation refers to a situation when there is continuous rise in the prices of goods and services.
